data.summary: Data Analyst with experience across settlements, investment banking reconciliation, securities reconciliation, fixed asset management, reporting and data validation. Strong hands-on capability in Advanced Excel, Excel Macros, VBA, MySQL, Power BI, Tableau, DAX and TLM. Experienced in analysing large datasets, decoding SQL logic, performing reconciliation and validation, preparing TDS/FDD/UAT documentation, and automating repetitive data-processing and reporting activities. Comfortable collaborating with business, operations, IT and client stakeholders.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data Analyst with experience across settlements, investment banking reconciliation, securities reconciliation, fixed asset management, reporting and data validation. Strong hands-on capability in Advanced Excel, Excel Macros, VBA, MySQL, Power BI, Tableau, DAX and TLM. Experienced in analysing large datasets, decoding SQL logic, performing reconciliation and validation, preparing TDS/FDD/UAT documentation, and automating repetitive data-processing and reporting activities. Comfortable collaborating with business, operations, IT and client stakeholders.
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS

• • • •
Advanced Excel: Pivot Tables, Pivot Charts, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, IF/IFS, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, conditional formatting, tables, charts and data validation. Excel Automation: Excel Macros and VBA for data formatting, report preparation, data consolidation and repetitive workflow automation. Data Analysis: Data cleaning, transformation, reconciliation, validation, exception analysis, large-dataset handling and business reporting. Analytics & BI: Power BI, Tableau, DAX, dashboard development, KPI reporting and data visualisation. Database & Applications: MySQL, SQL query analysis, TLM, Cognos, Power Query and basic Python. Documentation & Testing: TDS, FDD, UAT documentation, query validation, migration documentation and process improvement.
raw_sections.experience:
